title: Choosing a Guard Dog: A Practical Guide (SYNTHETIC)
description: Synthetic example page for pipeline tests.
paragraphs: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE TEXT - written for testing, not scraped from any website.
A good guard dog is loyal, alert and confident. Breeds such as the German Shepherd and the Rottweiler are often chosen for protection work.
Early socialization and obedience training are essential. A well-trained guard dog can tell the difference between a real threat and a visitor.
Larger breeds need daily exercise and mental stimulation to stay calm at home.
Many protective breeds are gentle with children when raised with them.
